core.title: Contoured Cabinet Knob, RK International CK-414

text.description_html:
RK International CK-414, Chic Contoured Cabinet Knob

A truly beautiful piece of cabinet hardware is not made with a superfluous amount of gaudy design. A truly beautiful cabinet knob is chic in its simplicity. The Contoured Cabinet Knob is available in black nickel (pictured), polished chrome, and polished brass finishes. We like the black nickel finish the best for its uniqueness and its stylish appeal but both of the other available finishes add their own beauty. The CK-414 Cabinet Knob has a 1-1/4 inch diameter. It is easy to install and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CK-414 Cabinet Hardware:

  • Material: Brass
  • Diameter: 1-1/4"
  • Projection: 9/16"
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
